name: test-harness
body: The shared test-helper layer: scratch-repo builders, the candidate-binary driver, and JSONL/fixture helpers used across tiers (today `src/testutil.rs` plus the per-module `mod tests` fixtures — 149 helper fns in `main.rs`, 105 in `plan_cmd.rs`, 104 in `layers.rs`, 75 in `splice.rs`). It must be reachable from both the sibling unit/int tests and the top-level e2e crates without duplication.
